# Why did Google Ads Editor skip rows in my bulk import?

> Catch what breaks a Google Ads Editor bulk import, with the line number, before you import. Nothing leaves your device.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
